## AI Research Findings (Dream Cycle 2026-04-03)

### PEAD.txt — Text-Based PEAD (JFQA 2022, validated 2025–2026)
- Constructs SUE.txt from earnings call transcript NLP — does NOT use the reported earnings number
- Daily alpha: SUE.txt = **3.9 bps/day** vs classic SUE = **2.6 bps/day** (50% improvement)
- Critical advantage: text signal PERSISTS in recent years when numeric PEAD has weakened to ~0
- Interpretation: numeric surprise is efficiently priced within hours; HOW management frames results is not
- Q&A section of earnings calls carries more signal than prepared remarks
- George application → R31: use FinBERT on earnings call transcripts to build text-based surprise metric
- Source: Meursault, Liang, Routledge & Scanlon, JFQA 2022. Still cited heavily in 2025–2026.

### Generative AI for Stock Selection (arXiv:2602.00196, Jan 2026)
- LLM + RAG to SYNTHESIZE FEATURES from analyst reports, options data, price-volume data
- Sharpe improvements: **+14% to +91%** over baselines depending on RAG corpus quality
- Key finding: RAG quality is the pivotal variable — knowledge base construction is the engineering bottleneck
- AI-generated features are weakly correlated with traditional factors → complementary, not redundant
- George application → R28 enhancement: instead of bare LLM calls for EarningsQualityAgent, build a mini-RAG per stock using 8-K filing + top 3 news headlines + prior guidance text
- This explains why bare LLM filtering fails (R26): no context = hallucinated judgment. RAG context = grounded judgment.

### AlphaLogics (arXiv:2603.20247, March 2026)
- Multi-agent system that mines the 'why' behind alpha factors (market logic) not just the factors themselves
- Bidirectional loop: factors improve logics, logics guide new factor generation → self-reinforcing
- Tested on CSI 500 (China) and S&P 500; outperforms baselines
- George application: not a direct backtest round, but the 'logic library' concept validates our heuristics.md approach
  → Each backtest finding should record not just 'what worked' but 'why it works' (the market mechanism)
  → This makes heuristics generalizable rather than curve-fit

### Research Sequence Update (2026-04-03)
- R28: TradingAgents overlay on PEAD — QUEUED (next to run)
- R29: LLM semantic filter on pairs trading — QUEUED (after R28)
- R30: Multi-quarter SUE elastic net — COMPLETED (disappointing; EN ≈ simple SUE on large-caps)
- R31: PEAD.txt text-based PEAD — QUEUED (can run in parallel with R28/R29; different data source)
- R32 concept: LLM+RAG feature synthesis for stock selection (arXiv:2602.00196 approach; higher complexity)
